page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 3.1 GHz. It features 32 physical cores and 32 vCPUs with a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, supported by a 35 MB L3 cache. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. It operates on a KVM hypervisor, lacks local storage, and delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Benchmark data places this instance in the average tier across multiple performance metrics. It achieves a stress-ng single-core CPU performance of 1436.68 and a multi-core score of 30666.35. Memory bandwidth tests show a high cached read-only small block speed of 1705.41 GB/sec, which drops to 109.89 GB/sec for uncached large blocks, alongside a write speed of 48.22 GB/sec. In application-specific tests, the instance processes 28.91 million Redis SET operations per second and achieves a static web serving throughput of 21.45 GB/sec. For lightweight machine learning tasks, it handles 135M model prompt processing at 1539.55 tokens/sec and 7B model text generation at 12.4 tokens/sec.

The lack of local storage requires reliance on external block storage, which may introduce latency tradeoffs for I/O-heavy applications. However, the dedicated CPU allocation and 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio offer stable, predictable performance for multi-threaded workloads. This hardware profile provides a cost-efficient balance for general-purpose enterprise applications, software compilation, database operations, and moderate web serving.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.8xlarge is a general-purpose instance featuring 32 dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY vCPUs running at 3.1 GHz on an x86_64 architecture. It is configured with 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB per core, and operates on a KVM hypervisor with a 10 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. The instance lacks local storage, requiring external block storage solutions. Performance benchmarks indicate solid multi-core capabilities, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 30666.35 and a Redis SET throughput of 28.91 million operations per second. It also demonstrates capable software compilation and text processing performance. This resource profile makes the ecs.hfg6.8xlarge highly suitable for enterprise web serving, database operations, software development pipelines, and moderate multi-threaded computational workloads where dedicated CPU performance is required without the need for local NVMe storage.
